about: Fixed utterance set for experiments/tts_bench.py (plan: docs/plans/voice-tts-plan.md section 3). `text` is what the engine is given; `spoken` is what a listener should hear, used for WER after normalisation. Tiers: earcon (tones, never synthesised live), clip (fixed confirmations, pre-rendered once and played from RAM; also synthesised live to measure the fallback), short (a confirmation with a dynamic slot), medium (one status sentence), long (a conversational reply), stress (numbers, times, abbreviations, names), barge (a long passage that is interrupted), i18n (optional, only for engines that support the language).
